title: Recipe 02: Table rows and batch actions
titleZh: 方案02：表格行与批量操作
summary: Stable row ids, a selected set, stale-id handling, and two bounded batch tools over a changing order list.
summaryZh: 稳定行 id、选中集合、旧 id 处理，以及两个有边界的批量工具。

guide.title: Represent a collection, not a pile of buttons
guide.titleZh: 表达集合，而不是一堆按钮
intro: Every row has a stable id. The selected set is explicit, and the batch result clears it.
Try an old selection after the filter changes; stale ids are ignored rather than applied to a different row.
introZh: 每行都有稳定 id。选中集合是显式状态，批量完成后会清空。
筛选变化后再使用旧选择；失效 id 会被忽略，不会误作用到另一行。

steps.title: Declare stable row identity
steps.body: The record carries the order id and only the fields that help a person and an agent decide.
steps.bodyZh: 记录携带订单 id，以及真人与 Agent 决策所需的字段。

steps.title: Expose the selected set
steps.body: The state view reports ids and counts, not the entire store.
steps.bodyZh: 状态视图只报告 id 与计数，不倾倒整个 store。

steps.title: Bound the batch operation
steps.body: One tool receives ids, rejects unavailable rows, clears the selection, and verifies that the open queue changed.
steps.bodyZh: 一个工具接收 id、跳过不可操作行、清空选择，并验证待处理队列发生变化。

guide.note: Use the checkboxes or ask the assistant to select SO-1042 and SO-1043, then approve them. Change the filter and try the old ids again.
guide.noteZh: 可以手动勾选，也可以让助手选中 SO-1042 与 SO-1043 后通过。切换筛选后再使用旧 id 观察结果。
